# Ben Hickman Photography - Full Site Content

Ben Hickman brings an editor's eye, lighting expertise on par with major studios, and a unique creative direction perspective. He specializes in providing cinematic, architectural, and unapologetically bold photography.

## About Ben Hickman
Cinematic, architectural and unapologetically bold photography. Ben is a photographer and creative director who works to create bold, impactful imagery.

## Collections
The portfolio features various collections of photography highlighting bold compositions and cinematic lighting. Each collection focuses on telling a visual story. (See individual collection links for specific imagery).

## Writing & Thoughts
Ben frequently writes about lighting, composition, creative direction, and the philosophy of image-making.
